sources.title: KIVI
sources.relevance: Asymmetric low-bit keys/values and a residual path. A low-bit cache with greater batching capacity is established.

sources.title: QServe
sources.relevance: Weight/activation/KV quantization and execution co-design. Keep weights fixed when isolating a KV mechanism.

sources.title: QuaRot
sources.relevance: Rotation-based end-to-end quantization. Rotation itself is not a novel FPGA method.

sources.title: TurboQuant
sources.relevance: Vector quantization with geometric distortion objectives. A generic Hadamard-plus-uniform codec is not automatically a reproduction.

sources.title: SAW-INT4
sources.relevance: Token-wise INT4, block rotations, paged/fused serving. Compare with serving-compatible INT4, not only an unfused reference. Author code: [saw-int4](https://github.com/togethercomputer/saw-int4).

sources.title: ReadKV
sources.relevance: Progressive retained/read precision, adaptive allocation, physical traffic and limited kernel timing. Full-model serving remains a distinct experiment.

sources.title: UltraQuant
sources.relevance: Native CDNA4 FP4 execution and agent serving. Its hardware path cannot be assumed to transfer to RTX 3090.

sources.title: vLLM TurboQuant study
sources.relevance: Contrasts capacity gains with throughput losses on tested systems. The best baseline depends on backend and hardware precision support.

sources.title: KVTuner
sources.relevance: Offline layer-wise K/V precision search. Layer sensitivity and mixed precision are already covered.

sources.title: MixKVQ
sources.relevance: Query-aware important key channels and mixed precision. Query awareness alone is not a contribution.

sources.title: RateQuant
sources.relevance: Quantizer-specific distortion calibration and bit allocation. Compare against calibrated allocation, not a poorly matched heuristic.

sources.title: Runtime-certified attention
sources.relevance: Tiered compressed state with original-data fallback and local bounds. Count retained originals and fallback cost; local bounds do not certify whole-model answers.

sources.title: KVarN
sources.relevance: Rotation/normalization for errors during long generation. Need natural autoregressive evaluation and a faithful method baseline.

sources.title: PM-KVQ
sources.relevance: Progressive precision reduction and memory allocation for long reasoning. Age-dependent precision is already established.

sources.title: KV²
sources.relevance: Selective reconstruction for reusable-context token eviction. Distinguish score refinement from retaining extra precision bits.

sources.title: Budgeted Cache Repair
sources.relevance: Row selection/recomputation for cross-context reuse. Repair and random-selector controls already exist.

sources.title: ReCache
sources.relevance: Composition-invariant tool-resource state with changed attention/positions. Arbitrary cache concatenation is not free.

sources.title: CacheSlide
sources.relevance: Position-aware reuse and correction. Prefix/position correctness must be part of any reuse experiment.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM compression framework
sources.relevance: Cold-page compression and runtime integration are shipping design topics. Review and pin exact platform support before reproducing.

sources.title: FlightLLM
sources.relevance: Complete FPGA mapping, arithmetic and memory hierarchy. Useful arithmetic/dataflow baseline.

sources.title: AccLLM
sources.relevance: Sparse attention plus W2A8KV4 and FPGA co-design. Combining pruning and low bits is established.

sources.title: FAST-Prefill
sources.relevance: Dynamic sparse attention, index pipeline and liveness-based cache. Prefill and decode require different bottleneck analyses.

sources.title: Embedded FPGA decoding
sources.relevance: Memory-capacity/bandwidth limits, fused execution and scale/zero packing. Good concrete baseline for accounting and data arrangement.

sources.title: GLITCHES
sources.relevance: GPU prefill/FPGA decode and scheduler-aware memory profiling. A hybrid split is not new and transfer costs must be charged.

sources.title: LUT-LLM
sources.relevance: Joint activation/weight VQ, centroid search and 2D lookup. Codebooks and on-chip read ports are part of the cost. Author code: [LUT-LLM](https://github.com/LUT-FPGA/LUT-LLM).

sources.title: LowRank-SSM
sources.relevance: Rank search plus projection datapath and memory scheduling. Use revised results; low-rank factorization alone is not the full method.

sources.title: LightMamba
sources.relevance: Rotation-assisted quantization and partially unrolled FPGA execution. Generic low-bit Mamba hardware is covered.

sources.title: FastMamba
sources.relevance: Quantization, element-wise/nonlinear execution and FPGA acceleration. Separate model sizes and prefill/decode timing boundaries.

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Super
sources.relevance: State rounding, RNG cost and completion-length behavior. Compare cheap rounding hardware against a strong stochastic reference.

sources.title: QuantSpec
sources.relevance: Hierarchical quantized cache plus self-speculation. Compression plus speculative execution is not a new combination.

sources.title: SpecKV
sources.relevance: Compression-aware draft-length control. Compare with the best fixed draft length and wall time, not only accepted tokens per step.

sources.title: RULER
sources.relevance: Multi-needle, tracing and aggregation tasks. A stronger synthetic quality set than repeated two-code lookup.

sources.title: LongBench v2
sources.relevance: Realistic multi-task understanding/reasoning. Select only examples that fit the model's supported context; disclose filtering.

sources.title: BABILong
sources.relevance: Distributed facts and reasoning in distractor text. Useful for testing memory utility rather than merely reconstruction error.

sources.title: KVFundaBench / ShotKV
sources.relevance: Reasoning-sensitive compression evaluation and semantic-unit retention. Do not infer reasoning quality from sparse retrieval.

sources.title: Sarathi-Serve
sources.relevance: Chunked prefill and decode-aware scheduling. A required scheduler baseline when cold requests stall active decodes.

sources.title: DistServe
sources.relevance: Prefill/decode disaggregation under response SLOs. Charge communication and evaluate both TTFT and token latency.

sources.title: TaiChi
sources.relevance: Unified aggregation/disaggregation and SLO-aware scheduling. Hybrid execution alone is not a new system concept.
